How AI is helping scientists uncover new leads for understanding and treating neurodegenerative diseases—and the brain research behind our collaboration with @perturbai_tx and @scrippsresearch:

We're announcing our first robot-use agent, Waddle-1. It controls bimanual robots on unseen tasks zero-shot.

Our agent is the most capable system evaluated by @robocurve, scoring 81 compared to 65 for GPT-6.2 Astra and 59 for Dream-1. It calls LLMs in the cloud to direct lower-level policies that run locally.

Waddle-1 is a first step towards agents that combine the capability of reasoning models and the efficiency of reactive policies. We expect such systems to achieve human-speed manipulation in the near future.

If you would like to deploy robots with our preview API, please tell us what you want to build here: waddlelabs.ai/api-access

Distillation can reproduce powerful AI capabilities without the safeguards built around them.

We’re sharing new research on our work to combat distillation of our models, how these capabilities transfer, and how we detect and disrupt coordinated attempts.

These findings are helping us sharpen our defenses and support safeguards across the industry.
